data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2020 were GBP 416.36m. During 2020 the syndicate recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 8.92m (approximately 2.1% of opening gross claims reserves) as shown in the movements table. The report notes that earlier underwriting years (notably the 2018 year of account) were impacted by a series of natural catastrophe events (Hawaii lava flow, Typhoon Jebi, Hurricanes Florence and Michael and Californian wildfires Camp and Woolsey) and that the 2019 year of account experienced COVID-19 related impacts and other catastrophe activity, but overall the 2020 movements show modest favourable development on prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2018 YOA has closed with a loss of GBP 13.8m after all standard personal expenses, equivalent to a loss on stamp capacity of 4.6%. The YOA has been impacted by a series of catastrophe events - Hawaii lava flow, Typhoon Jebi, Hurricanes Florence and Michael, and Californian wildfires Camp and Woolsey.

The 2019 YOA is forecast at the 24 month to make a mid-point profit of GBP 13.2m. The YOA has also been impacted by losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic, as well as a series of natural catastrophe events - predominately Hurricanes Sally, Laura and Zeta.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims taken from Note 12 'Insurance liabilities' (gross claims liabilities 416,360 GBP '000 at 31/12/2019). Prior-year movement taken from the 'Movement arising from prior years' row in the claims movements table (gross = (8,920) GBP '000). Gross premium mix was taken from the Managing Agent's divisional summary (calendar year column) because a statutory/regulatory segmental note was not present in the provided pages. Some mapping of events to LOBs is inferred; no event-specific quantified impacts were provided in the report pages supplied.
